title: 498. N-ary Tree Level Order Traversal

examples.explanation: Depth 0 holds 1, depth 1 its children, depth 2 the grandchildren.
Each depth collects the nodes at that distance from the root.

hints: Parse the bracket string into tokens and rebuild the N-ary tree with a queue.
Then run a standard breadth-first walk, slicing the queue per level.
An empty input yields an empty list of levels.
